fields.mechanism: Temperature and total dissolved solids concentration have a cumulative effect on the biofilm and spore formation of Geobacillus stearothermophilus.
fields.intervention: Implement a temperature control system that maintains a temperature of 55°C or lower in the district cooling loop, and adjust the total dissolved solids concentration to 20% (w/v) or lower to prevent biofilm and spore formation on the stainless steel plate heat exchanger channels.
fields.expected_effect: This intervention is expected to reduce biofilm and scale accumulation on plate channels, thereby maintaining a heat transfer coefficient above 2500 W/m2K for 12 months between mechanical cleanings.
fields.falsification_test: Monitor the heat transfer coefficient and pressure drop across the heat exchanger over a 12-month period, and perform regular cleaning and inspection to verify the effectiveness of the intervention.
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Increasing the total dissolved milk solids concentration to 20% (w/v) caused an apparent delay in the onset of biofilm and spore formation to detectable concentrations among all the strains at 55°C."

span_derivation.basis: shared content terms between span and mechanism+intervention; ratio < 0.20 = SPAN_UNDERIVED (the quoted span does not contain the mechanism's vocabulary)
